_comment: Copy to .claude/mcleod-ops/routes.json. The watcher matches each observed event against these routes top to bottom and dispatches the first match. Routes are data: edit this file to change routing, not the watcher's prompt.

autonomy_levels.observe: Read only. Summarize and report. Never write anywhere.
autonomy_levels.draft: Read, plus prepare unsent drafts and proposed McLeod field changes for a human to approve.
autonomy_levels.act: Read and write for real — send email, commit McLeod updates. Only ever set per-route, deliberately.

any_of: subject contains 'load tender' or 'tender' or 'new load' or 'rate confirmation'
body contains a pickup city/state, delivery city/state, and a rate
attachment is a rate confirmation or tender PDF
subject or body is a check call, ETA update, driver location, or delay notice
mcleod movement is in transit and has no tracking update within the SLA window
customer is asking 'where is my load' / 'status update'
message requests, confirms, or reschedules a pickup or delivery appointment
message contains a dock/warehouse scheduling portal confirmation number
message is a carrier packet, W-9, certificate of insurance, or authority document
sender asks to be set up as a carrier or to update their carrier profile
message contains an MC or DOT number and onboarding language
attachment is a BOL, POD, signed delivery receipt, lumper receipt, or scale ticket
body references documents for a specific order number
message is an invoice, short pay, billing dispute, or AP/AR question
carrier rate on the invoice differs from the McLeod rate on the order
mcleod order is delivered but unbilled past the SLA window

routes._comment: Deliberately unassigned. OS&D, cargo damage, injury, and legal threats are escalated to a human every time, never handled by an agent.

any_of: message mentions damage, shortage, overage, rejected freight, accident, injury, or a claim
message contains legal or escalation language

routes._comment: No handler yet. The watcher will propose building one via workflow-agent-builder once this pattern recurs.

any_of: message asks for a spot quote or rate on a lane

unmatched._comment: Unmatched events are logged to the ledger as workflow 'unrouted' and reported in the cycle summary. When the same shape recurs at or above build_threshold, the watcher proposes a new workflow agent.
